document.abstract: The Unit produces and distributes 16mm feature-length dramatic motion pictures on religious and educational themes, travelogues, documentaries, and promotional short subjects. Comprehensive courses leading to Bachelor and Master degrees in Cinema are offered. The studio and equipment facilities are on a scale perhaps unique among institutions of higher education. Unusual Films provides the “laboratory” for practical experience in all phases of motion pictures for students in the Division of Cinema of the Bob Jones University School of Fine Arts.
